title: Three Days and One Short Valve
subtitle: 应急救援 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 应急救援（人与自然·灾害防范·救援与急救）
meta: 主题语境：应急救援（人与自然·灾害防范·救援与急救）　|　核心词汇：intervention　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 intervention 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2003 the engineer ① planned the intervention that no worker in the plant would have recorded, and he said the planning was the whole of the day. The ② intervention, meaning the action itself and not the valve, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; an intervention, he said, is the only thing in a plant that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ intervention in that plant had the same short valve beside it, and the ④ intervention at the far pipe, meaning the repair they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An intervention, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the intervention was the whole of the matter, meaning the help and not the action. The ⑥ intervention, meaning the help and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; intervention, he said, is either something you plan or the only word that means both an action and a help. He said the help is the part they remember.

By 2008 the ⑦ intervention had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short valve. The ⑧ intervention of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in June, was one plant and three days of recording; intervention, he said, is either the repair at the far pipe or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ intervention I remember is the action recorded in the log, which closed in 2010 and is still recorded as the quietest in the plant. An ⑩ intervention, my mother said in 2012, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; every intervention, she said, is a help that has agreed to look like an action. She said the help was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 干预；介入（指厂房里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 干预；介入（指那次介入本身，与阀门相对）
C. 固定搭配：plan the intervention 安排这次干预
D. n. 干预；介入（指留给孩子们看着的一处那一次）
E. n. 救援之事（抽象总称，指一处厂房的干预之事）
F. n. 干预；介入（指记录里写到、被记下的的那一次）
G. n. 援手、帮助（指一件事里人人都救却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 帮助（抽象总称，指人人都救却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: planned the intervention that no worker in the plant would have recorded
The intervention, meaning the action itself and not the valve
the intervention at the far pipe
the intervention was the whole of the matter

answers.why: plan the intervention 意为“安排这次干预”，2003 年那位工程师把厂房里没有一位工人肯记录的一次干预做了一遍。
intervention 意为“干预；介入”，指那次介入本身而不是阀门，它经过了三个天而在簿子上没有被记录。
intervention 意为“干预；介入”，指厂房里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一个小小的阀门。
intervention 意为“干预；介入”，指最远那段管道留给孩子们看着的一处那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
intervention 意为“援手、帮助”，指一件事里人人都救却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份帮助就是那件事的全部。
intervention 意为“帮助”，指人人都救却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次介入，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
intervention 意为“干预；介入”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一次，到 2008 年这一次成了记录里的一行。
intervention 意为“救援之事”，工程师六月写道，整件事的干预之事是一处厂房和三个天的记录。
intervention 意为“干预；介入”，我记得的是记录里记录过的那一次，2010 年完成了，至今仍被说成厂房里最安静的一次。
intervention 为抽象总称，母亲 2012 年说，干预是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的介入。
